subject.title: [Bug]: opencode-go/minimax-m3 thinking content leaks to channel via Anthropic Messages path

question: Should OpenClaw authorize a provider-local opencode-go/minimax-m3 reasoning-disclosure fix now, and should the accepted mitigation force disabled thinking or use a proxy-specific sanitizer after live proof?
rationale: This is a security-sensitive reasoning disclosure path, and current MiniMax M3 docs warn that disabled thinking can produce empty visible output, so the final mitigation shape needs maintainer acceptance rather than an automatic fix PR.

options.title: Require live proof before choosing the fix
options.body: Ask for redacted opencode-go/minimax-m3 terminal/log or Telegram transcript proof, then accept the smallest provider-local payload or sanitizer fix that preserves final output.

options.title: Force disabled thinking explicitly
options.body: Maintainers can accept overriding non-off thinking for this proxy model if they also require regression coverage and upgrade/proof notes.

options.title: Use a sanitizer path
options.body: If live proof shows disabled thinking drops answer text, prefer an opencode-go MiniMax sanitizer that strips leaked reasoning while preserving final responses.

recommendation.title: Require live proof before choosing the fix
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted opencode-go/minimax-m3 terminal/log or Telegram transcript proof, then accept the smallest provider-local payload or sanitizer fix that preserves final output.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest current routing candidate from recent opencode-go stream localization and provider SDK history.
